field_CHAT_MEMORY_MAX_CHARS_desc: Oldest turns are dropped once the history exceeds this many characters; the latest pair is always kept

guide.studentTitle: How do I hand in this homework?
guide.studentIntro: There are two kinds of homework: if the teacher asks for a chat transcript, talk it through in Knowledge Q&A and submit; if they ask for files, upload Word/PDF/sheets/slides or a photo of your work.
studentSteps: Check the submission type tag and the requirements first - do you hand in a chat transcript or files, and when is the deadline.
Chat transcript: in Knowledge Q&A ask the AI questions, discuss, let it check your reasoning until the conversation is complete.
Files: click the submit button and drag or pick files (on a phone you can take a photo). The dialog header shows how many files, the size cap and how many attempts you have left.
You can resubmit before the deadline - only the last attempt is graded. Late submissions are usually still accepted but tagged as late.
After submitting, click a file name to download what you handed in. Until the teacher publishes, the row shows "Grading".
Once published, open Score to see the total, per-dimension scores, the requirement checklist, comments and next steps.
To redo it: ask your teacher to revert your submission in Details, then complete it again and resubmit.
guide.teacherTitle: How do I assign and grade?
guide.teacherIntro: Assignments come in two types: chat transcripts (students work it out with the AI and hand in the conversation) and files (Word/PDF/sheets/slides/images). In both cases the AI grades first and you publish after review.
teacherSteps: When creating homework, pick the submission type first: chat transcript / files / files + note. The requirements are the AI rubric - write checkable items ("includes data sources", not "work carefully").
Not sure how to word it? Use "Draft with AI": choose the type, describe your idea, and the AI returns the title and requirements - for file homework also scoring dimensions and suggested file types.

File homework lets you set: deadline, allowed types and count (default 3 files, 10MB each), submission attempts (default 3), full score and dimensions. Late uploads are still accepted and only tagged.
After students submit, the Submitted column shows the headcount and how many still need grading; file homework is tagged in the name column and the list has a Deadline column.

Click the eye icon: for chat homework read each transcript; for file homework the grading board shows every file, its extracted text or image preview, plus similarity check and a zip download of the whole class.

Grade with AI: the robot icon grades the whole chat class at once; for file homework use "Grade whole class" (runs in background - images are read by a vision model first, progress visible) or "Re-grade this student".
Results include per-dimension scores, a per-requirement checklist (met / partial / missing) and quotes from the work. If a judgement is off, use "Review / edit" - the original AI score is kept.
Students only see scores after you "Publish grades" (they get a notification and grade-level bonus points). Use revert to let a student redo, and the check icon to close the homework.

field_CHAT_SKILL_SEGMENT_MODE_desc: Keep “inside system prompt” in most cases
field_CHAT_META_MAX_TOKENS_desc: Output cap for identity/greeting answers (100-4000 tokens, default 600) so a one-line question never becomes a 1000-word lesson.
hwModeLockedHint: Students already submitted; submission type is locked
hwDeadlineNote: Late uploads are only tagged, never auto-deducted; decide that in the rubric or when editing scores
hwPolicyReview: AI grades first, teacher publishes after review (recommended)
hwDimSum: Dimensions total {{sum}} / full score {{total}} (rescaled automatically if mismatched)
hwClosedWarn: Deadline passed — this upload will be marked late
hwNoteHint: e.g. design ideas, data sources, division of work
hwUploadHint: Word (.docx), PDF, Excel, PPT, text and images; images are read by a vision model
hwNoText: No extracted text (scanned or unparsable) — download the original
hwJobTimeout: Grading is still running in background — refresh later instead of resubmitting
hwSimFound: {{n}} similar pairs flagged in the grading board
hwSimWarn: Similar submissions (flag only — the teacher decides)
field_HOMEWORK_MAX_FILE_MB_desc: Per-file limit for homework uploads and the ceiling teachers can set
field_HOMEWORK_MAX_FILES_desc: Default number of files allowed per submission (teachers may lower it per homework).
field_HOMEWORK_ENABLE_VL_desc: For image homework (handwritten photos, artwork, screenshots) a vision model transcribes and describes the file before grading. If off, images can still be submitted but grading falls back to manual. Independent of the chat multimodal toggle.
hwNoTimesLeftHint: Ask your teacher to revert your submission in the assignment details to submit again.
hwPickFirstAgain: No new file selected: pick the file(s) to re-submit above (already uploaded files need not be re-added)
skillNoneEnabledDesc: AI features still work, but fall back to the base model's default style: less structure, fewer examples, weaker follow-up guidance and no content-safety layer. Use "Enable all" at the top right to restore it.
skillRecommendedTip: Carries a baseline guardrail (e.g. content safety). Turning it off won't break the feature but removes that constraint
taskMobileReadonlyHint: Mobile is view-only: edit, AI grading, ending and deleting tasks need the desktop app.
field_wrong_practice_threshold_desc: Once a student's pending mistakes exceed this number, a practice set is pushed automatically; 0 means push whenever any mistake exists.
field_wrong_practice_per_set_desc: How many questions each auto set contains (1-20). Selection prefers frequently-missed and long-neglected questions, avoiding recent sets.
field_wrong_practice_interval_days_desc: Minimum days between two auto sets. It also decides how long an unanswered set keeps blocking new pushes; stale sets are then closed automatically.
field_wrong_practice_avoid_recent_sets_d: Exclude questions served in the last N sets (0 = no exclusion). Falls back to the full pool when too few candidates remain.
field_wrong_book_sources_desc: Which activities feed the mistake book. Exams are always on and cannot be turned off; practice, quick quiz, class questioning, course practice and class ladder can each be toggled (only activities whose questions map back to the bank are offered). Changes apply on save and never rewrite existing rows.
wbsTodoTip: No ingestion path for this activity yet — ticking it has no effect until it is wired up
loginGateDesc: For maintenance windows: turn off login for specific roles or external traffic. Administrators are unaffected; signed-in users are sent back to the login page on their next request.
reloadConfirmContent: {{n}} unsaved changes will be lost after reloading.
zone_school_desc: Branding, subjects, notification types and the honour wall. Set once at deployment.
zone_teaching_desc: Points, quests, mistake practice, student portraits and classroom tools. Tuned day to day.
zone_storage_desc: Upload and download limits, sessions, access protection and version sync.
optBankModeAi: Generated by AI on the fly
field_AGENT_EDITION_tip: For example “Math Edition” or “Biology Edition”. Display only.
field_SHOWCASE_AUTO_ENABLED_tip: Opening the page also tops up missing cards; a background sweep catches students whose points just became positive. Cards removed by a teacher are never revived.
field_APPID_tip: Create it at Bailian → Application Center → My applications → Create agent app → copy the APPID. The APPID must belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account as DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.
field_KB_API_BASE_tip: Enter the bare domain (e.g. https://llm-xxx.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com); /compatible-mode/v1 is appended automatically. Chat and knowledge retrieval prefer it. It must belong to the same workspace as the API key, otherwise retrieval fails with Agent application not found.
field_QWEN_OPENAI_API_BASE_tip: Used directly when the dedicated domain is empty. A full URL with path is also accepted and normalised to /compatible-mode/v1.
field_KB_ENABLED_tip: Every business that used the APPID agent (questions, lesson plans, grading, analytics, whiteboard) switches to direct + Bailian knowledge retrieval. In chat, the “Knowledge” toggle still controls retrieval per message (off by default). Disabling or incomplete config restores the previous behaviour.
field_CHAT_MEMORY_ENABLED_tip: Adds a small amount of input tokens. Disabled behaves exactly like no memory.
field_IMAGE_GEN_MODEL_tip: Default is wan2.2-t2i-flash. Tested models use their measured endpoint and size rules; untested ones fall back to the conservative 512–1440 range. Models not listed can be typed in.
field_PORTRAIT_AUTO_PUSH_tip: At each new period, one portrait is generated for active students and pushed, costing one LLM call and one image call each. Off by default; for large schools switch the period to monthly first.
field_CLASS_LADDER_DEFAULT_SKIN_tip: Light: cloud, sunrise, mint. Dark: star, cyber, academy, classic.
field_HOMEWORK_MAX_FILE_MB_tip: When deploying behind IIS, remember to raise the request filtering limit as well.
field_HOMEWORK_ALLOWED_EXTS_tip: Legacy .doc/.ppt/.xls cannot be parsed safely and are rejected by default; ask users to save as .docx/.pptx/.xlsx.
field_TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS_tip: Keep it off when directly exposed to the internet, otherwise clients can spoof their source IP and bypass bans.
field_ENABLE_IP_GUARD_tip: Off by default: behind Hsk/NAT traversal all remote visitors share the relay IP, so IP bans can hit everyone. Turning it off only affects banning; failed IP+UA+referer are still logged.
field_ENABLE_REQUEST_LIMIT_tip: Counts AI chat (Q&A, knowledge, companion) and the whiteboard assistant; administrators are exempt. Off by default.
field_auto_pull_enabled_tip: Syncs are written to upgrade history. Database migrations or dependency changes are never auto-synced; upgrade manually instead.
field_TTS_VOICE_tip: Voices are not interchangeable between the two models. Defaults: News anchor (male) for 3.0, Long Sanshu (male) for 3.1.
